rationale: Map Next Wave Energy to the existing Next Wave Energy Partners, LP platform and correct the single ECP ownership period without adding a duplicate owner. Preserve ECP's 2015 initial investment while recording the disclosed Fund IV attribution and March 2018 current-fund chronology without inferring an undisclosed recapitalization or sponsor exit. Project Traveler and Pasadena Performance Products remain subordinate facility and project entities.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Next Wave Energy Partners, LP
companyFieldUpdates.description: Next Wave Energy Partners, LP is a Houston-based downstream and midstream infrastructure platform that develops, owns and operates toll-processing, manufacturing and logistics assets for natural gas liquids, petrochemicals and gasoline blend components. ECP first invested alongside management in 2015 with an equity commitment of up to US$500 million; ECP reports a March 2018 investment date and later identifies Next Wave as a Fund IV investment. Those disclosures establish continuous ECP ownership but do not disclose the Fund IV transition mechanics, acquisition vehicle or stake. Project Traveler is the platform's Pasadena, Texas alkylate facility, and Pasadena Performance Products is its project subsidiary rather than a separate PortCo. The 53-acre facility was originally designed for 28,000 barrels per day and reached commercial operation December 28, 2023. No later platform or asset sale, ECP exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
